titre: File:X-ray of ground glass opacities of pneumocystis pneumonia.jpg
auteur: Carolyn M. Allen, Hamdan H. AL-Jahdali, Klaus L. Irion, Sarah Al Ghanem, Alaa Gouda, and Ali Nawaz Khan
description: Pneumocystis pneumonia : These chest radiographs are of two patients. Both show -ground glass appearance. The left chest X-ray (CXR) shows a much more subtle ground-glass appearance while the right CXR shows a much more gross ground-glass appearance mimicking pulmonary edema.
